descriptionByLocale.it:

• Un aspetto convincente e la capacità di comunicare con diversi stakeholders
• Conoscenza tedesca molto buona in parola e scrittura

descriptionByLocale.en:
Every day, nearly 4000 employees of the BLS ensure that our trains are reliable and safe on the move. During operation, you are already working on the railway infrastructure of tomorrow. You coordinate challenging projects along our routes and make sure that our brand promises of lived everyday life remain: BLS connects. This is waiting for you:
• You guide our demanding construction projects in the field of railway technology – from initial planning to successful implementation
• The overall coordination of railway technology during the execution phase is your responsibility, with you working closely with the departments
• With a view to detail, you make sure that costs, quality and appointments always remain in line
• With a wide view, you plan the use of team, machines and operational intervals and thus create the basis for project success
• Clear focus on security: You make sure that work security and web-specific guidelines are always at the first place This is what you bring:
• Higher training in the construction sector, ideally as a construction manager:in, technician:in or equivalent training
• professional experience in one of the specialist areas of railway technology (travel, automation or energy)
• A convincing appearance and the ability to communicate with different stakeholders
• Very good German knowledge in word and writing
• Category B driving licence Your advantages – you can look forward to this:
• Get a GA 2nd class, a GA 1. Class or half-taxabo.
• Work where it suits you best. Whether in the home office or in the office. We promote part-time work, top and job sharing
• It is possible to buy five to ten holiday days a year in addition
• Financial support for external training and an exciting internal learning and course offer are available to you.
• With seasonal events and courses we support your health. BLS With nearly 4000 employees, BLS is the second largest railway company in Switzerland. More: We are also a shipping company, a real estate company, an international freight train, a bus company and transport cars safely through the Lötschberg and the Simplon. What links us? The pride of what we do every day. Mobility has many facets for us. And many exciting jobs.

Mit fast 4000 Mitarbeitenden ist die BLS das zweitgrösste Bahnunternehmen der Schweiz. descriptionByLocale.it: Pronto per un'avventura rivoluzionaria nel settore dei binari? descriptionByLocale.en: Ready for a groundbreaking adventure in the track sector? In this role, you're not just driving one of our modern two-way baggers, but you're also directly involved in track construction. Whether you're behind the wheel of the bagger or out on the job site, your assignments are varied, responsible, and technically demanding. Here's what we expect from you: - Operation of our Liebherr A922 Rail including all attachments - Independent small maintenance of the bagger and equipment - Execution of bagger work, transports, and interventions in the track sector - Active participation in track construction - you're flexible and not just as a machine operator Here's what we expect from you: - Training as a machine operator, at least category M1, M2 preferred - Basic training on two-way baggers VTE10 or willingness to complete it - Experience in track construction or construction industry preferred - Driver's license category B (or category F up to 45 km/h) - Stamina, independence, and high flexibility - Willingness to work nights and weekends - Good German language skills Your benefits - what you can look forward to: - We promote a flexible planning of your tours and shifts - You receive a GA 2.
